## What you lost and why

### 1. The Combo "Duplicate" button — **removed by a merge, not destroyed**
- The duplicate feature was added in commit `6754d9c0` (Aug 18): *"feat(combos+models): combo duplicate, dev flag, model chooser sorting, capability overrides, model import"*
- It **still exists** on `master`, on `merge-upstream-20260910`, and in worktrees `t_4a2534ba`/`t_828425aa`
- But your **current branch `gap-retry-01/t_2031a48a` (HEAD) does NOT have it** — `git merge-base --is-ancestor 6754d9c0 HEAD` = **NO**. The current branch diverged from master (1 commit vs 229) and the duplicate feature was never merged into this line.
- **mini2's installed app (v0.5.65, built Sep 11 14:37) was built from this same branch line** — its bundled combos page has **0** references to "Duplicate". That's why the button is gone on mini2.

### 2. Your data is NOT gone — it's all still in the DB
- mini2's `~/.9router/db/data.sqlite` is **249MB, alive, updated today 14:54** — with **3 combos** still in it
- The pre-merge backup `pre-merge19-20260910-224820/data.sqlite` also has **3 combos** — same data
- So the combos themselves survived; only the **UI feature to duplicate them** disappeared

### 3. The "messaging service tracking" — still in the app
- mini2's bundle has `/api/v1/messages/` route (with `count_tokens` sub-route) — the messaging API is intact
- The DB has `requestDetails` + `requestDetails_fts` (full-text search) tables — request tracking is intact
- What's likely missing is a **dashboard UI tab** for it, or it was part of the same unmerged local work

### 4. What "destroyed" it — the timeline
| Date | Event |
|------|-------|
| Aug 18 | Duplicate feature added (`6754d9c0`) on a local branch |
| Sep 10 21:36 | `a0650fda` "merge-prep: stage all local work for upstream merge" |
| Sep 10 22:48 | mini2 backup `pre-merge19` taken (data intact: 3 combos) |
| Sep 11 14:37 | mini2 app **v0.5.65 rebuilt** — from the branch line **without** the duplicate feature |
| Now | Current HEAD (`gap-retry-01`) still lacks it |

**Bottom line:** Nothing was maliciously destroyed. The **Sep 11 rebuild of mini2's app came from a branch that never included the local combo-duplicate work** — the feature lives on `master`/`merge-upstream-20260910` but was never merged into the `gap-retry-01` line your app was built from. Your data (3 combos, request tracking, messaging API) is all still in the DB.

export function validateResponseBody(body, status) {
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object") {
    return { valid: false, reasons: ["EMPTY_BODY"] };
  }
  const reasons = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(body.choices) || body.choices.length === 0) {
    reasons.push("EMPTY_CHOICES");
  } else if (!body.choices[0]?.message?.content && !body.choices[0]?.delta?.content) {

}

- `validateResponseBody({choices: [{message: {content: null, tool_calls: [...]}, finish_reason: "tool_calls"}]})` → valid — the doc version would return NO_CONTENT since content is null and no delta.content. Need to check tool_calls.

```js
export function validateResponseBody(body, status) {
  if (body == null) return { valid: false, reasons: ["EMPTY_BODY"] };
  if (typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) return { valid: false, reasons: ["NON_OBJECT_BODY"] };
  const reasons = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(body.choices) || body.choices.length === 0) {
    reasons.push("EMPTY_CHOICES");
  } else {
    const choice = body.choices[0];
    const hasContent = Boolean(choice?.message?.content) || Boolean(choice?.delta?.content);
    const hasToolCalls = Array.isArray(choice?.message?.tool_calls) && choice.message.tool_calls.length > 0;
    if (!hasContent && !hasToolCalls) reasons.push("NO_CONTENT");
    if (choice?.finish_reason === "error") reasons.push("FINISH_REASON_ERROR");
  }
  return { valid: reasons.length === 0, reasons };
}

export function isMalformedResponse(body) {
  const result = validateResponseBody(body);

One approach:
```js
export function validateResponseBody(body, status) {
  if (body == null) return { valid: false, reasons: ["EMPTY_BODY"] };
  if (typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) return { valid: false, reasons: ["NON_OBJECT_BODY"] };
  const reasons = [];
  if (!Array.isArray(body.choices) || body.choices.length === 0) {
    reasons.push("EMPTY_CHOICES");
  } else {
    const choice = body.choices[0];
    if (choice?.finish_reason === "error") {
      reasons.push("FINISH_REASON_ERROR");
    } else {
      const hasContent = Boolean(choice?.message?.content) || Boolean(choice?.delta?.content);
      const hasToolCalls = Array.isArray(choice?.message?.tool_calls) && choice.message.tool_calls.length > 0;
      if (!hasContent && !hasToolCalls) reasons.push("NO_CONTENT");
    }
  }
  return { valid: reasons.length === 0, reasons };
}
```

- `{choices: [{}]}` → NO_CONTENT, valid: false ✓
- valid completion → valid: true, reasons: [] ✓

- null → EMPTY_BODY ✓
- "html error page" → NON_OBJECT_BODY ✓
- finish_reason error → FINISH_REASON_ERROR only ✓

export function repairBodyText(rawText) {
  if (typeof rawText !== "string") return { ok: false, error: "UNREPAIRABLE" };
  try {
    return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(rawText) };
  } catch {
    // Best-effort: strip markdown fences and trailing commas, then retry
    try {
      const cleaned = rawText
        .replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, "")
        .replace(/\s*```$/, "")
        .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, "$1");
      return { ok: true, value: JSON.parse(cleaned) };
    } catch {
      return { ok: false, error: "UNREPAIRABLE" };
    }
  }
}
```

That's a reasonable implementation without adding deps.

  { type: "research_report", keywords: ["research", "report", "analysis", "investigate"] },
  { type: "creative_writing", keywords: ["story", "poem", "essay", "creative", "fiction"] },
  { type: "summarization", keywords: ["summarize", "summary", "tldr", "brief"] },
  { type: "translation", keywords: ["translate", "translation"] },
];

export function classifyTask(messages) {
  let lastUserContent = "";
  for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const msg = messages[i];
    if (msg.role === "user") {
      if (typeof msg.content === "string") lastUserContent = msg.content;
      else if (Array.isArray(msg.content)) {
        lastUserContent = msg.content.filter(c => c.type === "text").map(c => String(c.text || "")).join(" ");
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!lastUserContent.trim()) return "general_chat";
  for (const rule of TASK_RULES) {
    if (rule.keywords.some(kw => lastUserContent.toLowerCase().includes(kw.toLowerCase()))) return rule.type;
    if (rule.patterns?.some(p => p.test(lastUserContent))) return rule.type;
  }
  return "general_chat";
}

// ── Model Scoring ──────────────────────────────────────────────

const TASK_WEIGHTS = {
  "code:generation": { tools: 3, reasoning: 2, contextWindow: 2 },
  "code:debugging": { tools: 3, reasoning: 3, contextWindow: 2 },
  "agent:multi_step": { tools: 3, reasoning: 3, contextWindow: 3 },
  math: { reasoning: 3 },
  reasoning: { reasoning: 3, contextWindow: 2 },
  research_report: { reasoning: 2, contextWindow: 3, search: 2 },
  creative_writing: { contextWindow: 2 },
  summarization: { contextWindow: 3 },
  general_chat: { contextWindow: 1 },
};

}
